title: IAEA Live Chart: 131I half-life 8.0252 d (uncertainty from the seconds column)
summary: The Live Chart row for 131I lists half-life 8.0252 with unit d. The seconds columns fix the absolute uncertainty at 0.0006 days.
body: The IAEA Live Chart ground-state row for 131I (Z=53, N=78), extracted 2026-11-18, lists half_life 8.0252, unit_hl d, unc_hl 6, half_life_sec 693377.28, and unc_hls 51.84. Dividing half_life_sec by half_life gives 86400 seconds per unit, so unit code d is days in this row. Dividing unc_hls by that same number gives an absolute uncertainty of 0.0006 days. The small integer unc_hl (6) matches that absolute uncertainty as 6 in the last significant place of the printed half-life, not as 6 days on its own. The leading decay field is B- at 100 percent. The row's ENSDF publication cut-off field is 17-Jul-2006. This is the database row, not a new laboratory measurement made for this card.
